name: Zen Archer
summary: A bow-focused Monk who flurries at range, attacks with Wisdom, channels ki through arrows, and bends shots around concealment and cover.

featureOverrides.summary: Gain the normal ki pool and may spend 1 ki to increase a bow's range increment by 50 feet for 1 round.
Choose a Zen Archer bonus feat from its ranged-combat list without meeting prerequisites.
Choose a Zen Archer bonus feat from its ranged-combat list without meeting prerequisites.
Choose from the expanded Zen Archer ranged-combat bonus-feat list without meeting prerequisites.
Choose from the complete Zen Archer ranged-combat bonus-feat list without meeting prerequisites.

features.name: Bow Flurry
features.summary: Gain bow proficiency and flurry only with a bow; Rapid Shot and Manyshot cannot modify the flurry.

features.name: Perfect Strike
features.summary: Gain Perfect Strike for bows; at 10th level roll three attack dice and keep the highest.

features.name: Way of the Bow (Weapon Focus)
features.summary: Gain Weapon Focus with one bow type without meeting prerequisites.

features.name: Way of the Bow (Weapon Specialization)
features.summary: Gain Weapon Specialization with the same bow type without meeting prerequisites.

features.name: Zen Archery
features.summary: Use Wisdom instead of Dexterity on ranged attack rolls with bows.

features.name: Point Blank Master
features.summary: Gain Point Blank Master for bows without meeting prerequisites.

features.name: Ki Arrows
features.summary: Spend 1 ki to use unarmed-strike damage dice for arrows until the next turn.

features.name: Reflexive Shot
features.summary: Make attacks of opportunity with arrows while continuing to threaten with unarmed strikes.

features.name: Trick Shot
features.summary: Spend 1 to 3 ki to ignore concealment, total concealment, cover, or total cover for 1 round.

features.name: Ki Focus Bow
features.summary: While at least 1 ki remains, arrows count as ki focus weapons for special ki attacks.
